integrity: Self-contained analytic proof and reproducible computational corroboration; historical priority provisional; no independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: The formula concerns intrinsic distances within a standalone truncated hyperbolic cusp, not arbitrary ambient surface distances. The large-distance estimate is for each fixed positive boundary-horocycle length. No noisy-data stability bound is proved.
title: A universal leading tail and a horocycle-length signature for random distances in a hyperbolic cusp
